storage: one gzipped JSONL per HALF-MONTH publication unit under <archive>/secftd/ (<YYYYMM><a|b>.jsonl.gz, ~58k rows ≈ 3.5MB plain → ~1.5MB gz, gz-on-write); period-level dedup (a published half-month file is final)
written_by: server/secFtd.ts refreshFtd (12h poll over the newest 5 half-month periods; eager boot; 2004→present history backfill is a SEPARATE filed task — ~370MB gz total, volume-budget decision first)
source: SEC CNS fails-to-deliver (sec.gov cnsfails zips; contract live-verified 2026-07-07): URL pattern NON-uniform across 5 eras since 2004 — poller tries the verified fallback chain (standard path → /files/data/other/ → _0 suffix; the 202605a file lives at the second variant TODAY, confirmed live end-to-end). Half-month boundary VERIFIED as 1st-14th ('a') / 15th-EOM ('b'), publishing ~EOM and ~15th-next-month (2.5-4.5wk lag). Pipe-delimited single-.txt zips (dependency-free ZIP reader, stored+deflate); pure ASCII; LF current / CRLF 2004-era. TWO trailer lines = free integrity checksum, enforced (mismatch refuses the file; live 202606a matched exactly: 58,328 rows). Default UA → 403; SEC-etiquette UA used.
license: US government work, public domain — the resale-safe census source; attribution 'SEC CNS fails-to-deliver data'
attribution: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (CNS fails-to-deliver)

field_map.date: ISO settlement date (source YYYYMMDD, business days only)
field_map.cusip/symbol/name: 9-char CUSIP OR CINS (letter prefix = foreign, ~9% of rows — never validated numeric); name is source-truncated at 30 chars, trailing spaces stripped
field_map.qty: aggregate net CNS fail BALANCE outstanding that settlement date — a LEVEL, not a daily flow (consecutive dates = the same balance evolving); min observed 1 (no 10k-share reporting floor in current files)
field_map.price/rt: prior-day close, or null when source prints '.' (~0.6% now, 100% of 2004-era rows); rt = our capture date

confidence_model: RAW official CNS fails data. HYPOTHESIS (gate-locked): raw FTD spikes are maximally crowded — the edge is ONLY the settlement-stress composite (threshold-list persistence x FTD level x daily short volume; census #4/#6 joint), computed against the finrathreshold + finrashortvol archives. Nothing claimed until ladder gate 2.
cadence: half-month files: 'a' (1st-14th) publishes ~EOM same month, 'b' (15th-EOM) ~the 15th next month; 12h poll
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). DATACORE MAXIMUS census build #6. History depth available upstream: 2004-03-22 (quarterly-era files have different URLs/multi-member zips — backfill task covers them).
